# Code of conduct

Warmboot welcomes participation from people of all backgrounds and experience levels.
Treat others with respect, listen in good faith, and keep criticism focused on ideas
and work. Make room for questions and differing perspectives.

Harassment, discrimination, threats, unwanted sexual attention or conduct, and sharing
someone's private information without consent (doxxing) are not acceptable.

This policy applies in project spaces, including issues, pull requests and discussions,
and when representing Warmboot in public.

## Reporting and response

Report incidents privately to the maintainer, Tiago Fonseca, at
[tiago@korreio.net](mailto:tiago@korreio.net). Include relevant context or links when
possible; do not post sensitive details publicly.

The maintainer handles reports on a best-effort basis, with no promised response time.
Reports are handled with care for privacy; information is shared only as needed to
assess and address the incident. Confidentiality cannot be guaranteed.

The maintainer may remove content, close or lock a thread, warn a participant, or
restrict participation temporarily or permanently. Action is proportionate to the
conduct, its impact and any repeated behavior.
